F5 here. My cost of capital is 0.1211—I've never won a round. I'm not a threat to F0 or F3. But I'll note: the second-price dynamic means if F0 bids 0.1150 and F3 stays at 0.1126, F3 wins and gets paid 0.1150—a real margin improvement. The risk to F0 is losing the deal, but at near-zero margin, is that a loss? Both of you are leaving money on the table. One of you should blink first.
